academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2025-26; reviewed on 2026-08-24
note: The official four-page Architectural Studies Study Scheme explicitly applies to students admitted in 2025-26 and publishes 34 unique ARCH code-title-unit rows. The downloaded PDF was 154,480 bytes with SHA-256 9301ed316b20221fd3fdb938148e8030ec9ba9505094655d045feed3d6d2d8ea and was verified through full text extraction and visual review of every rendered page. The standard-entry Major requires 78 units: 9 Faculty Package units, 30 Studio units, 33 Other Required units and at least 6 Elective units with at least one three-unit course. Separate senior-entry paths require 59 units for Associate Degree holders and 56 units for Higher Diploma holders, each using a narrower 11-course elective pool. The Faculty Package lists external course codes without their Programme-specific titles or per-course units, and the three entry paths have different requirements. Therefore only the complete official ARCH Course List is exposed for browse-only planning with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage. ARCH1002 and ARCH1320 appear in the official Course List but not in the published 2025-26 Major requirement, so they remain labelled as additional Programme courses rather than inferred electives.
